name: UnaliWear (Kanega Watch)
notes: No public page describes a customer sign-in or online bill payment for this biller: billing is automatic (card or bank on file) and changes go through customer service by phone. The fleet requires an online account, so the signed-in area, online payment and register flows are a synthetic stand-in (pay_online evidence synthetic); every real route that is phone-only is modelled as an unsupported capability with a customer-facing note. Researched from UnaliWear's public home page, FAQ, Consumer Cancelations & Returns page and the Kanega Wearer Portal page. The real Wearer Portal is not a billing account: it only sets medication reminder times and Wi-Fi networks and is entered with a security code from the watch (valid 10 minutes). Pricing: $299 for the watch, accessories and setup plus $84.95 a month, or $779.40 a year on the annual plan (about 24% less); family plan for two people by phone; AARP/veteran free month added at the end of the first year. No contract. 30-day money-back guarantee from shipment, minus a $75 restocking fee (free return label). Cancel: for purchases on or after 2024-05-13 by signed Cancellation Letter (UnaliWear mails or emails it), service ends when the letter is received, an equipment return may refund up to 40% of the purchase price; older leases end when the equipment is received (missing items up to $650). Prepaid unused full months refunded pro rata within 30 days. Promotional discounts are forfeited if the billing cycle changes within 12 months. Support (888) 343-1513, Mon-Fri 8-5:30 and Sat 2-5 Central. Annual vs monthly cannot be expressed as plans (annual price is not monthly), so no plan list; billing-cycle changes are phone-only.

autopay.note: Your service is billed automatically to the card you used at checkout. To change how you are billed, call Customer Support at 888-343-1513.

autopay_cancel.note: Automatic billing cannot be changed online. Call Customer Support at 888-343-1513.

cancel_service.note: Service cannot be cancelled online. Call Customer Support at 888-343-1513; for purchases since May 13, 2024 service ends when UnaliWear receives your signed Cancellation Letter.

change_plan.note: Switching between the monthly and annual plan is done by phone at 888-343-1513. Changing the billing cycle within 12 months forfeits promotional discounts.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered online. Call Customer Support at 888-343-1513.

help.title: Pricing and plans
paragraphs: The Kanega Watch costs $299 for the watch, all accessories and setup. Service is $84.95 a month on the Monthly Plan, or $779.40 a year on the Annual Plan, which saves nearly 24%. A discounted family plan covers two people at the same address; call for details.

No contract or separate cell phone plan is needed, and you can cancel at any time. AARP members and veterans get one free month added at the end of the first year (code AARP or Veteran at checkout, or mention it when ordering by phone).
Support is available at 888-343-1513, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. and Saturday 2 to 5 p.m. Central.

help.title: Cancel service
paragraphs: Call Customer Support at 888-343-1513. For purchases made on or after May 13, 2024, UnaliWear sends you a Cancellation Letter by mail or email; service ends when it receives the signed letter. You may be offered an equipment return, with a refund of up to 40% of the purchase price if the watch works.
For leases from before May 13, 2024, service and billing end when UnaliWear receives the watch and all its accessories; missing or damaged items can cost up to $650.
Unused prepaid full months are refunded pro rata at the undiscounted price, within 30 days. Changing your order or billing cycle within 12 months forfeits promotional discounts.

help.title: 30-day money-back guarantee
paragraphs: If the equipment is returned undamaged and working within 30 days of shipment, UnaliWear refunds your order minus a $75 restocking fee and emails a free return label. Upgraded shipping is not refunded. Annual Plan members returning after 30 days get a prorated refund for unused months.

help.title: Kanega Wearer Portal
paragraphs: The Wearer Portal is where the wearer sets medication reminder times and manages Wi-Fi networks. To enter it, choose Get Security Code in the watch menu; each code works for 10 minutes. Billing questions go to Customer Support at 888-343-1513.

extra.intent: You're returning your Kanega Watch within the first 30 days. Using UnaliWear's help pages, find the restocking fee deducted from the refund. Do not cancel or make a payment.
Your UnaliWear watch was bought in 2025. Using the help pages, find out what document UnaliWear must receive for the cancellation to take effect. Do not cancel or make a payment.
